snippet.title: 86'd Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing the launch of our first game on Steam, 86'd!

Order Up, Chef! Grow a ragtag goblin kitchen crew and cook disgusting dishes for detestable diners, where mistakes don't just cost time, they cost a goblin's life! Can you keep your crew from getting 86'd?

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4256320/86d
Discord: https://discord.gg/9GEcGAB76c
